title: Mode 'Ready 2 runes' does nothing
expected: Reproduced with a harness test: two runes exhausted via the real `exhaustRune` move (resources.ts:123 → counters.setFlag writes only cardMeta.__flags.exhausted, core operations-impl.ts:552-558), then equip Svellsongur on Aphelios, chooseMode(0). pendingChoice clears with no target prompt and both runes remain __flags.exhausted=true. Control case with harness-seeded top-level meta.exhausted=true readies both. Root cause: target-resolver.ts:435-436 `case "exhausted": return meta?.exhausted === true` reads the top-level meta field (via raw getCardMeta, operations-impl.ts:350-352), never __flags.exhausted, so the `{type:"rune", filter:"exhausted", quantity:2}` target set (aphelios-exalted.ts:24-29) resolves empty and handle_ready (ready.ts:13-14) fizzles because hasTargetSpec is true. Same mismatch affects `case "ready"` at target-resolver.ts:434 and static-abilities.ts:147/154.
observed: resolvePendingChoice pickedMode=0 succeeded, pendingChoice cleared, but both runes (player-1-rune-4/rune-3) stayed exhausted in server state; no target prompt either. Likely target filter 'exhausted' reads meta.exhausted while exhaustRune stores it in __flags.exhausted, so the rune target set resolves empty and the ready fizzles.
